t: A browser demo for exploring how Stable Diffusion makes images from text.
steps: Find DiffusionDemo on the AI4K12 resource list.
Download the DiffusionDemo Activity Resource Guide.
Open the demo in a browser using http.
Check that the site loads on a student device.
Try one prompt and look at the result.
Review all prompts for school safety before students use the demo.
Follow the guide step by step.
